title: Using Deep Learning for Task and Tremor Type Classification in People with Parkinson's Disease.
summary: Personalized BiLSTM classifiers using sEMG distinguished tremor classes (88±5% mean accuracy) and task labels (84±8%) in 15 participants with Parkinson’s disease; the study was offline and does not demonstrate treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Methods §§2.2–3.3: BiLSTM plus regularized evolutionary hyperparameter search on sEMG.
organization: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

evidence.tested: Methods §3.1, Results §§4.1–4.2: 15 PwP; five-task and three-class tremor results as summarized.
evidence.unknown: Methods §3.2: person-specific models use first 80% / final 20% of each time series; offline, no person-generalized validation.
